EVIDENCE 2026-10-20: the SQL half is now proven in CI. db-tests boots a fresh local Postgres, applies every migration in order and runs the whole pgTAP suite, which includes supabase/tests/space_email_reply_aliases.test.sql; it passed on the last migration PRs merged to main (run 895 and earlier, all required-check green), and the migration is applied in production. Earlier notes saying the pgTAP was authored but not run no longer hold. WHAT REMAINS: the live pilot only (an authenticated send and reply on the Daniel Tyack Space, then a second-Space isolation check), which needs Daniel's hands; steps are in the thread.

CLOSED 2026-10-20. PASS 2026-10-20: the SQL half runs green in the required db-tests check (fresh database, every migration applied, whole pgTAP suite), the migrations are applied in production (confirmed in the production migration list), and the live pilot is observed: Resend lists people.frequencylocal.com Verified, the owner's pilot send was accepted and delivered, the reply threaded back into the Space conversation, and the second-Space isolation check passed (EMAIL-028 evidence).
